name: Standing broad jump
protocol: Warm up for 5 minutes with easy cycling or jogging, then 8 squats, 5 reverse lunges per side and 2 submaximal practice jumps.
Place both toes behind a measured line, using the same foot width each time. Arm swing is allowed.
Jump forward from two feet and land on two feet. Hold the landing for 2 seconds without falling or stepping back.
Measure from the take-off line to the nearest heel. Record centimetres.
Complete 3 valid attempts with 90 seconds rest between attempts. Keep all values and use the best valid distance.

A fall, backwards step or one-foot landing invalidates that attempt.
Do not compare jump tests performed with different arm rules or measurement conventions.

name: 10 m acceleration
protocol: Use a dry, flat track with a clear run-off area. Mark 0 m and 10 m accurately.
After a dynamic warm-up, complete 3 progressive 20 m runs at approximately 60%, 75% and 90% effort, with 60 seconds rest.
Use a standing start with the front toe behind 0 m. Start from stillness without rocking or a run-up.

For fixed video timing, time from the first visible movement until the torso crosses 10 m. Record the frame rate and timing definition. With timing gates, record the exact start offset and gate configuration as a separate protocol.
Run 3 maximal trials, resting 3 minutes between trials. Keep the best valid time and the timing method.

name: Pro agility 5-10-5 yard course in metric units
protocol: Place three parallel lines with the outer lines 4.572 m to either side of the centre line. The full width is 9.144 m.
Practise the sequence at half speed once in each direction. Start straddling the centre line in the same documented stance each time.
Run 4.572 m to the first line and touch it with the hand, turn and run 9.144 m to the opposite line and touch it, then turn and run 4.572 m through the centre.
For video timing, start at first movement and stop as the torso crosses the centre line on the final return.
Complete 2 valid trials starting left and 2 starting right, resting 3 minutes between trials. Record the best time in each direction.
frequency: Baseline after familiarisation; programme test weeks 1, 10, 18, 26, 34, 42 and 50. Use recovered conditions.
precautions: Use the same surface, shoes, equipment and measurement method at each assessment.

name: Original 40 m 30-15 Intermittent Fitness Test
protocol: Use the original 40 m official 30-15 IFT audio. Mark lines at 0 m, 20 m and 40 m with the official 3 m tolerance zones and space beyond each end.
Complete a light dynamic warm-up and practise following the audio before the assessment.
Run for 30 seconds and recover for 15 seconds. The original first stage is 8 km/h, increasing by 0.5 km/h every stage.
During each 15-second recovery, walk forward to the next marked line as directed by the audio. Do not walk backwards to a closer line.
Stop at voluntary exhaustion or when unable to reach the end-zone tolerance on three consecutive occasions.
Record the speed of the last fully completed stage as VIFT. Complete only one maximal test that day.
frequency: Baseline after familiarisation; programme test weeks 1, 10, 18, 26, 34, 42 and 50. Use recovered conditions.
precautions: Use the same surface, shoes, equipment and measurement method at each assessment.

name: Submaximal strength reference
protocol: Choose the usual wrist-tolerated main lift. Record its exact variant, equipment, depth or handle height and any straps.
Complete the session warm-up, then 3 gradual practice sets of 5, 3 and 2 repetitions at easy effort, resting 60, 90 and 120 seconds respectively.
Perform one technically consistent reference set of 3 to 6 repetitions at RPE 7 to 8, leaving approximately 2 to 3 repetitions in reserve. Rest 3 minutes before the set.
Record load, completed repetitions, RPE, technique and symptoms. Stop if form changes or pain appears.
For tracking only, calculate Epley estimate = load in kg x (1 + repetitions / 30). Save the actual set as the primary observation.

name: Controlled stickhandling quality reference
protocol: Use the same stick, Green Biscuit or ball, floor surface and two markers 30 cm apart each time.
Complete 60 seconds of comfortable easy handling, then rest 60 seconds.
Perform narrow forehand-backhand handling for 30 seconds at a controllable pace. A touch means one deliberate blade contact moving the object across the marked space.
Record total touches, errors and valid controlled touches. Count an error when the object escapes the space or control is lost.
After 60 seconds rest, repeat once. Keep both trials and compare controlled touches together with error count, wrist response and eyes-up percentage.
frequency: Baseline after familiarisation; programme test weeks 1, 10, 18, 26, 34, 42 and 50. Use recovered conditions.

name: Shooting target accuracy reference
protocol: Use the same safe shooting setup, puck, pad, stick, shot type and measured distance. Default reference distance is 3 m where safe space permits.
Set five fixed target areas: top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right and five-hole. Record each target size and position before the first test.
After 5 comfortable non-counted practice shots and 60 seconds rest, take 5 shots at each target, for 25 counted attempts total.
Rest 15 seconds between shots and 60 seconds between target groups. Use one shot type for each test.
Record attempts and hits by zone. Accuracy = total hits / total attempts x 100. Keep speed and release time separate if measured.
frequency: Baseline after familiarisation; programme test weeks 1, 10, 18, 26, 34, 42 and 50. Use recovered conditions.
precautions: Use the same surface, shoes, equipment and measurement method at each assessment.
Record sleep, soreness, recent training and any symptoms. Testing replaces a workout; it is not an extra maximal session.

protocol: After the shared dynamic warm-up, perform 2 submaximal practice jumps.

name: Single-leg lateral hop and stick
protocol: Mark the centre of the starting heel on a dry, stable surface. Keep hands on hips.
Stand on the right leg, hop laterally to the right, and land on the right leg. For the left leg, mirror the task to the left.
Hold each landing for 2 seconds with the free foot off the floor and without hopping again.
Measure lateral displacement from the starting heel centre to the landing heel centre.
Complete 3 valid trials per side, alternating legs, resting 60 seconds between attempts. Record the best distance for each side.

name: Fixed-load submaximal cycle reference
protocol: During a familiarisation session, select a fixed wattage and cadence that produces RPE 3 to 4 during a 6-minute ride. Save bike model, seat setting, resistance, wattage and cadence.
On each assessment, warm up for 5 minutes at easy effort.
Ride for 6 minutes at the exact familiarisation wattage and cadence on the same bike.
Record mean heart rate during the final 60 seconds, final RPE and heart rate 60 seconds after stopping in the same recovery posture.
If no heart-rate monitor is available, record wattage, cadence and RPE with heart rate left blank. Do not fabricate a score.
